value.answer: Lowest I can find today is about 4.34% for a 5-year fixed if your mortgage is insured (under 20% down). If you put 20% or more down, the lowest is around 4.44%. The big banks are higher, averaging about 5.14%, and BMO just moved its standard 5-year fixed up to 5.14%. Rates have been creeping up this month.
